# Clause audit (generated by `python3 audit.py CLAUSE-AUDIT.md`; do not edit)

Review 13 of GoodQA #16096. Every clause of `clauses.CLAUSES` (THRESHOLDS.md, cited line by line) is split into the separate conditions (conjuncts) its registered words impose. A conjunct is decided by one place in `verdicts.py`, from a figure that one recorder function computes from raw rows (`results/<life>.rows.gz`, `.poll.gz`, `.oracle.gz`, `.writes.gz`) or from a primary matrix cell. It is ESTABLISHED, VIOLATED or NOT_ESTABLISHED; a gate is PASS only when every conjunct of it is ESTABLISHED, and a clause only when every conjunct of every gate deciding it is ESTABLISHED on every life of the campaign inventory. A clause is FAIL only when one of its own conjuncts is VIOLATED. Figures with no raw record (the EXP3 migration figures, `exp2.writes` and EXP2-T1 for lives without saved oracle legs) are withheld when a conjunct is established (`summarize.gate_view`): they can never make a PASS, and a failure they record still makes the gate FAIL (`summarize.judged`).

Each conjunct has a test (`tests.test_clauses.ConjunctViolationTests`) that changes the RAW record of a passing base (committed down_7 or up_1 rows, poll and oracle; a synthetic write record) so that only that conjunct stops being established, runs it through parse, reduction (`summarize.rebuild`) and the verdict, and asserts the gate and every clause citing the conjunct are not PASS. A conjunct whose registered words are an AND of several conditions has one more input per further condition (`half`, `tests.test_clauses.HALVES`). `also` lists a conjunct the same raw change cannot avoid moving; `whole` marks a conjunct the evidence type enforces (its violation leaves the evidence unparsed); `figure` marks the cases with no raw record.

## Totals on the committed lives

- Clauses: 76 (PASS 12, FAIL 2, UNVERIFIED 62).
- Distinct conjuncts: 53 (ESTABLISHED 17, VIOLATED 1, NOT_ESTABLISHED 35), of which 3 are LIMIT conjuncts that are never established. Clause-to-conjunct citations: 113.
- Ungated clauses (REPORTED or RULE): 24; every one is UNVERIFIED (no conjunct is established by a gate).

A conjunct is counted ESTABLISHED here only if it is established on every inventory life of its gates; per-life counts are in each table.
